subject: Economics
grade_scope: IEB NSC papers are Grade 12 externally-examined papers only; Grade 10-11 assessment at IEB schools is school-set per the SAG programme of assessment, so no national IEB Gr 10-11 papers exist to index (the CAPS tree's Gr 11 papers are DBE/provincial, a different examining body).

library.access: Guest credentials published by the IEB itself on its FAQ (guest@ieb.co.za / guest) - intentionally provided public access, analogous to the DBE's public download links.
folders: NSC Public Resources > NSC Examination Papers
NSC Public Resources > NSC Marking Guidelines

portal_coverage: Roughly the five most recent examination years of IEB NSC question papers are published as a free study aid; older papers are supplied on request via NSCexampapers@ieb.co.za.
marking_guidelines_note: Availability is UNRESOLVED on secondary evidence: one research pass found 'papers + marking guidelines for the previous 5 years', another found 'most marking guidelines are not published publicly'; the docs.ieb.co.za guest library does carry an 'NSC Marking Guidelines' folder. Resolve on the first verified portal/library visit and replace this note with what is actually there. The question-linking pipeline must plan for papers whose marking guideline is unavailable (memo-method matching needs it): request via NSCexampapers@ieb.co.za or record the paper index-only.

sessions_contract: sessions[] entries follow the CAPS per-subject index shape: {"session": "November 2025 IEB NSC", "session_page": ..., "papers": [{"paper": 1, "language": "English", "question_paper_url": ..., "memo_url": ...}]} - omit memo_url when the marking guideline is unpublished; never point it at a third-party re-upload. fetch_ieb_sources.py fetch-papers records raw portal links into captured_links[] for hand-shaping into sessions[].
